headline: Oil Prices Edge Up Amid Strait of Hormuz Attacks Despite Supply Surplus
summary: Global crude oil prices rose slightly as new attacks were reported on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, though gains were capped by forecasts of an upcoming global oil supply surplus.
why: Oil price movements directly influence input costs for global transport, manufacturing, and energy sectors, driving broader macroeconomic inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Directly tracks global crude oil benchmark prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Geopolitical disruptions and vessel attacks in the Strait of Hormuz heightened supply security fears, offsetting oversupply concerns.
